_source.name: GEM Foundation, Country/Territory Seismic Risk Profiles v2026.0.0 (Global Seismic Risk Model)
_source.citation: A. Rao, K. Aljawhari, M. Baiguera, A. Calderon, M. Caruso, C. Costa, D. Gonzalez, A. M. B Nafeh, M. Nastasi, M. Simionato, V. Silva, C. Yepes-Estrada (2026), Country/Territory Seismic Risk Profiles of the GEM Foundation. https://github.com/gem/risk-profiles/

_source.how_read: Profile PNGs were downloaded in the build session and the risk-indicator table, loss curve, loss-by-region chart and major-earthquake list were transcribed from image crops (confirmed_by page_read; chart readings carry the stated precision).

units.loss_curve: Million USD (mean loss at return period)

KAZ.read_note: Values transcribed from the GEM profile PNG (5847x4134 px) using a 1200 px overview plus four crops (indicators table, loss curves, loss-by-region chart, major-earthquake list). The 10/50/100-year losses are printed on the chart to 0.1 M USD ($13.6M, $162.5M, $332.3M); the 500- and 1000-year values are printed only as $1.1B and $1.7B, so they are rounded to +/-50 M USD. Loss-by-region values are the bar labels ($6.9M, $5.7M, $1.8M, $756.4k, ...), converted to M USD. Region names follow GEM's (pre-2018/2022) boundaries: 'South Kazakhstan Region' includes Shymkent, 'Almaty Region' includes today's Jetisu Region.
major_eq: Kemin (Chon-Kemin), Kyrgyzstan/Almaty (GEM marks with * = outside or on border)
KAZ.loss_by_region_check: Sum of bar labels = 16.29 M USD vs. table total AAL 16.255 M USD (difference is label rounding).
KAZ.version: GEM Country Seismic Risk Profiles (risk-profiles repository, master branch; README states social indicators for 2026 population / 2024 GDP / 2023 HDI, costs in 2025 USD)
gaps: 500- and 1000-year losses are only printed as $1.1B and $1.7B on the chart (precision +/-50 M USD).
Loss by line of business per return period is not labelled (only stacked bars); not transcribed.
Building-class percentages were not transcribed (not requested).

KGZ.read_note: Values transcribed from the GEM profile PNG (5847x4134 px) using a 1200 px overview plus four crops (social/risk indicator table, loss-curve chart, loss-by-region bar chart, major-earthquake list). The 10- and 50-year losses are printed on the chart to 0.1 M USD ($25.3M, $418.8M); the 100-, 500- and 1000-year values are printed only as $0.8B, $2.1B and $2.7B, so they are rounded to +/-50 M USD. Loss-by-region values are the bar labels ($11.4M, $10.0M, $4.6M, $2.3M, $960.9k, $811.5k, $726.7k, $622.0k, $80.6k) converted to M USD; 'Osh Shaary' and 'Bishkek Shaary' are the city units (shaary = city), 'Osh' and 'Jalal-Abad' the oblasts. The table total replacement cost (52.3) is 0.1 below the sum of the three lines (52.4) because of rounding in the source.
major_eq: Kemin (Chon-Kemin); printed as M 8.2 with an asterisk = epicentre outside or on the border (Kyrgyzstan/Kazakhstan)
KGZ.major_eq_note: The 'M7.x' column is the literal magnitude printed on the profile: 1911 M 8.2, 1992 M 7.5, 2008 M 6.6 (USGS ComCat gives Mw 8.02, Mwb 7.3 and Mwc 6.7 respectively).
KGZ.loss_by_region_check: Sum of bar labels = 31.50 M USD vs. table total AAL 31.582 M USD (difference is label rounding).
KGZ.version: GEM Country Seismic Risk Profiles (risk-profiles repository, master branch; README states social indicators for 2026 population / 2024 GDP / 2023 HDI, costs in 2025 USD; 100,000-year event-based simulation, residential+commercial+industrial buildings only)
gaps: 100-, 500- and 1000-year losses are printed only as $0.8B, $2.1B and $2.7B on the chart (precision +/-50 M USD).
Loss by line of business per return period is not labelled (only stacked bars); not transcribed.
Building-class percentages were not transcribed (not requested); the chart shows adobe/earth and unreinforced masonry as a large share of the building count.

TJK.read_note: Values transcribed from the GEM profile PNG (5847x4134 px) using a 1200 px overview plus four crops (social/risk indicator table, loss-curve chart, loss-by-region chart, major-earthquake list). The 10/50/100-year losses are printed on the chart to 0.1 M USD ($29.1M, $268.7M, $478.1M); the 500- and 1000-year values are printed only as $1.4B and $2.5B, so they are rounded to +/-50 M USD. Loss-by-region values are the bar labels ($10.3M, $6.5M, $4.6M, $3.0M, $797.5k) converted to M USD; their sum (25.2 M) matches the table total AAL 25.27 M within label rounding. Region names are GEM's: 'Nohiyahoi Tobei Jumhuri' = Districts of Republican Subordination (DRS), 'Kuhistoni Badakhshon' = Gorno-Badakhshan (GBAO). The 475-year PGA map shades the Dushanbe-Hisor area and the Rasht/Surkhob valley in the 0.2-0.5 g class and most of the rest of the country in 0.1-0.2 g (read from the map colours, not from a legend value).
major_eq: Karatag (Qaratog, Hisor range, Tajikistan-Uzbekistan border; GEM marks with * = outside or on border)
Tajikistan (Khait/Hoit, Rasht valley; USGS ISC-GEM gives Mw 7.5)
TJK.major_eq_note: GEM's 3,500 deaths for 1949 is lower than Wikipedia's ~7,200 (earthquake plus the Khait landslide); some estimates give up to 28,000. GEM's 12,000 for 1907 is the low end of the 12,000-15,000 range.
loss_by_region_m: Nohiyahoi Tobei Jumhuri (Districts of Republican Subordination)
TJK.loss_by_region_check: Sum of bar labels = 25.20 M USD vs. table total AAL 25.27 M USD (difference is label rounding).
TJK.building_classes_note: Building-class chart (by replacement value): unreinforced masonry about 40%, concrete about 25%, adobe/earth about 13%, other about 10%, with the remaining classes small; by count the stock is dominated by adobe/earth (about 36%) and unreinforced masonry (about 33%) - read approximately from the stacked bars.
TJK.version: GEM Country Seismic Risk Profiles (risk-profiles repository, master branch, fetched 2026-11-16; README states social indicators for 2026 population / 2024 GDP / 2023 HDI, replacement costs in 2025 USD; risk from an event-based analysis simulating 100,000 years of earthquakes; residential, commercial and industrial buildings only)
gaps: 500- and 1000-year losses are printed only as $1.4B and $2.5B on the chart (precision +/-50 M USD).
Loss by line of business per return period is not labelled (only stacked bars); not transcribed.
Building-class percentages are read approximately from stacked-bar labels and may be off by a few points.
The profile gives no uncertainty ranges; GEM's 1949 and 1907 fatality counts differ from Wikipedia/NGDC-based figures.

TKM.read_note: Values transcribed from the GEM profile PNG (5847x4134 px) using a 1200 px overview plus three crops (social and risk indicator tables; major-earthquake list; loss-by-region bars with loss curves). All five loss-curve values are printed on the chart to 0.1 M USD ($2.1M, $36.2M, $73.6M, $241.2M, $387.5M). Loss-by-region values are the bar labels ($1.1M, $1.1M, $846.4k, $809.5k, $79.8k, $30.4k) converted to M USD; the two $1.1M labels are rounded, so the Balkan and Ahal shares are +/-0.05 M USD. Region names follow GEM/GeoBoundaries ('Asgabat' = Ashgabat city as its own unit; Ahal excludes the capital). Building classes by count: adobe/earth 41%, other 21%, unreinforced masonry 17%, wood 9%, confined masonry 7%, remainder steel/concrete; by value: concrete 55%, confined masonry 12%, wood 8%, unreinforced masonry 8%, other 8%, adobe/earth 5%, remainder steel.
major_eq: Turkmenistan (Kazandzhik area; USGS ISC-GEM Mw 7.0, 40 km NE of Balkanabat, 1946-11-04)
Ashkhabad (Ashgabat; USGS ISC-GEM Mw 7.15, 14 km N of Ashgabat, 1948-10-05 UTC)
TKM.loss_by_region_check: Sum of bar labels = 3.97 M USD vs. table total AAL 4.045 M USD (difference is the rounding of the two $1.1M labels; Balkan + Ahal together = about 2.28 M USD).
TKM.version: GEM Country Seismic Risk Profiles (risk-profiles repository, master branch; README states social indicators for 2026 population / 2024 GDP / 2023 HDI, costs in 2025 USD; boundaries GeoBoundaries)
gaps: The Balkan and Ahal bars are both labelled $1.1M, so their individual AAL is known only to +/-0.05 M USD.
Loss by line of business per return period is not labelled (stacked bars only; residential dominates at every return period, commercial about 15% at 1,000 years); not transcribed.
The 1948 death toll of 110,000 is GEM's figure (NOAA/EM-DAT based); Wikipedia gives 10,000-110,000 and some sources up to 176,000 - disputed.

UZB.read_note: Values transcribed from the GEM profile image (seismic_risk_profile_Uzbekistan.png, v2026.0.0) at full resolution. Loss-curve values are the bar labels: 10-yr $203.6M (exact to 0.1M); 50/100/500/1000-yr labels are rounded to 0.1 B USD ($1.5B, $3.0B, $8.9B, $12.3B), so those four values carry +/-50 M USD rounding uncertainty. Loss-by-region bars are labelled to 0.1 M USD. Social indicators: population and growth for 2026 (UN WPP 2024), GDP and GDP per capita for 2024, HDI for 2023, replacement costs in 2025 USD (per README).
major_eq: Fargona Viloyati (Fergana Region; epicentre just inside Kyrgyzstan)
UZB.major_eq_note: As printed on the profile ('1902 M 6.4 - Andizhan - 4,880 fatalities; 2011 M 6.1 - Fargona, Violyati* - 14 fatalities; 1966 M 5.0 - Tashkent - 10 fatalities'). The asterisk is GEM's own mark. Other sources give the 1966 Tashkent event as Mw 5.2 with 15-200 deaths (Wikipedia) and the 2011 event as Mw 6.1 (USGS).
UZB.loss_by_region_note: Bar chart 'Loss by region' (average annual loss, M USD). Sum of listed bars = 146.2 M USD, matching the national AAL total of 146,186 k USD. 'Toshkent' without 'Viloyati' is read as Tashkent city.
UZB.building_classes_note: Building-class pie (proportion of exposed value / count): confined masonry, steel, concrete, wood, other, unreinforced masonry, adobe/earth; by value the largest shares read as about 36% unreinforced masonry, 34% confined masonry, 19% concrete, 6% other/steel (approximate; small labels).
UZB.hazard_map_note: PGA map (475-yr, rock): highest class (>0.2g to 0.5g) over the Fergana Valley / Tashkent region and the Gazli area west of Bukhara; 0.1-0.2g over Tashkent and Samarkand; lowest (<0.05g) in the Kyzylkum desert and Karakalpakstan.
UZB.version: GEM Country Seismic Risk Profiles v2026.0.0 (README states values for population 2026, GDP 2024, HDI 2023, costs in 2025 USD)
gaps: Loss-curve values for 50-1000 yr are rounded bar labels (0.1 B USD precision); the underlying CSV was not downloaded.
Building-class percentages are approximate readings of small pie labels.

Population 37.7 M (UN WPP 2024 projection for 2026) differs from the national statistics figure of about 38.2-39 M (Jan 2026, stat.uz via Wikipedia); the GEM value is kept here for consistency with the loss model.
